title: Settings leak between users
hints: Create two users, change one, then log both. Are they really two separate objects all the way down?
The spread operator {...obj} copies only the top level. Nested objects are still shared.
Give every user their own notifications object, and make sure nothing can change DEFAULTS (structuredClone helps).

hiddenTestRules.preferences > keeps two existing users i: Changing one user's preferences never changes another user's.
hiddenTestRules.preferences > doesn't let sign-up choice: Choices made at sign-up only affect that user
hiddenTestRules.preferences > keeps the other channels w: Choices made at sign-up only affect that user, and keep the other defaults
hiddenTestRules.preferences > protects the defaults from: code that reads them (like getDefaults(), which the settings page uses for "Reset to defaults") must not be able to change them.
hiddenTestRules.preferences > regression: rejects an unk: setNotification throws for a channel that doesn't exist.
